headline: DO: GET A COUNTER BACK ON 198 RENA TODAY — the buyer's agent has now asked twice and gone a day and a half without an answer, and your authority to represent those sellers runs out August 14, which is eight days. · DECIDE: two counter numbers are on the table and the recommendation is A. · WATCH: TYLER'S LICENSE COMPLIANCE AT REAL IS DATED TODAY — two notices came in overnight, the second one subject-lined as an offboarding risk for 8/6, and he is the open agent-of-record question on a closing whose payout is already nine days stranded.

notes: 🔑 SEVENTH RUN BLOCKED BY ONE SIGN-IN, AND THE STRANDED PILE IS NOW A WEEK DEEP. All three boards rebuilt and committed again this morning; none of them can publish. The GitHub CLI has been signed out since Monday's migration and the Mac keychain still holds no credential. What your phone shows is Tuesday 8:05 AM — two and a half days behind this file, and the marketing graphics are queued behind the same lock. `gh auth login`, once, in Terminal, and everything ships on the next pass.

✅ THE WARM-15 RECONNECT LANE IS ALIVE AGAIN AFTER FIVE DARK DAYS — and the diagnosis was not what anyone assumed. The manifest was staging correctly the whole time; it was writing to Drive while the executor was reading this Mac, so fifteen past-client reconnects were built and then read by nobody. Fifteen are staged and healthy this morning against a fresh double-touch check, gate at 9:15. ⚠️ These are NOT Tuesday's stale queue — that batch stays retired, correctly.

⏸️ NINETEEN HOURS OF SHOWINGTIME SILENCE, AND IT IS A REAL READ RATHER THAN A DEAD FEED. Not one event since yesterday 7:46 AM — no bookings, no feedback, no cancellations — verified against the full fourteen-day pull. Nothing is owed and nothing was missed. 🛡️ Agent outreach stays suspended exactly as you ruled Monday; the two send-safety ledgers are still genuinely absent from this Mac and from Drive, so nothing machine-written went to a buyer's agent.

callBlock.why: STILL THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ANYWHERE ON YOUR BOARD, and it has been sitting three days. Her buyer wants to write on the Altamont unit and is short on down payment, nothing else. ⭐ THE PHONE IS THE ONLY DOOR: with agent outreach suspended by your own Monday ruling, no machine will ever send this one for you.

🔴 THE WORST NUMBER ON THIS LIST: ZERO TOUCHES, EVER. Third buyer off your 1709 Fieldstone ad in three days, re-engaged himself on a Sunday afternoon, and nothing has ever gone out to him in any channel. Three days overdue.

Fourth name off the same Fieldstone ad in four days, landed Sunday evening while the instant responder was dead — so she got the silence, not the D0. ⚠️ Three days old and still untouched by anything automatic.

New IDX buyer from Sunday night, and the phone is effectively the only channel — her only email is an Apple private relay, the exact address type this system has already watched bounce. Anything you send in writing may never arrive.

New buyer off the Fieldstone ad whose email HARD BOUNCED — nothing you or any machine sends will ever land. ⚠️ If she does not get a call she gets nothing at all, and that has been true for three days.
Asked you to call her twice inside twenty-five seconds, then followed with a slab-leak question, then named the issue herself in a later text. Three separate reaches, still no call back.

⚠️ A PROMISE MADE IN YOUR NAME IS NOW A DAY PAST DUE. Brand-new buyer off the 1709 Fieldstone ad, and the email that went out under your signature told him you would call him that day. That is the one kind of overdue that costs you the lead outright.

⭐ THE ONLY NAME HERE WITH PAPER BEHIND IT — you hold a SIGNED referral agreement on this seller, and the listing consult you booked never happened. This is not a lead to qualify; it is a commitment already made on both sides that nobody has finished.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $450K — the counter ask is a day and a half old and the listing agreement dies Aug 14
listings.note: 🔥 THE ONE THING ON THIS BOARD TODAY, AND IT NOW HAS A DEADLINE BEHIND IT. His second voicemail asked for a counter number and named his own ceiling out loud while doing it — a buyer negotiating against himself, which only happens while he thinks somebody is listening. ⏰ THE NEW FACT: your listing agreement expires 2026-08-14 — EIGHT DAYS — and the counter under discussion proposes an Aug 31 contingency deadline, seventeen days past your authority to represent these sellers. That date lived only in a milestone subject line until this morning; nothing tracked it. ⚠️ THE SEQUENCE IS STILL THE PROBLEM: you cannot quote a counter your sellers have not approved, so the seller call comes first — and neither call has happened.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $164K — a named buyer wants to write, and the decision is still yours to make
listings.note: 🔥 The only YES on the board, now four days old. ⚠️ THE OPEN QUESTION IS UNCHANGED AND IT IS A DECISION, NOT A TASK: authorize a concession and trade a later close for a signed contract, or hold at list and let her buyer wait on a bonus that may or may not arrive. ⚠️ HONEST NOTE — you have still not asked your seller for a number, so today's version of this question has nothing behind it either. ⏰ This file has also read AGREEMENT EXPIRING since 7/22 with no date ever pulled from the notice; that is fifteen days of an unread clock.

listings.status: 🔥 Active $295K — TODAY at 11:00 AM, the only scheduled event on your entire calendar
listings.note: ⭐ THIS MORNING IS THE TEST. The first fresh booking this listing has taken since three separate buyers said the number was wrong, confirmed on the same notice that carried the cut from $299,000. 🔥 CHASE THE FEEDBACK INSIDE THE HOUR — it is the single most informative read you will get this week, and it decides whether the cut bought real traffic or one curious agent. ⛔ Nobody has ever named a replacement number: every price-recommendation field on all three reads came back blank. Quote $295,000 only.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $369K — inspection ran 8/5 at noon, and 20 hours later nothing has come back
listings.note: ⏳ STILL A WAITING GAME RATHER THAN A SCHEDULING ONE. ShowingTime confirmed it in writing and the MLS line on that notice reads CONTINGENT; as of this morning there is no report, no repair request and no call from either side. That is still normal, and it is still the thing most likely to change today. ✅ NOTHING IS OWED BY YOUR SIDE: the dotloop addendum is an ADDRESS CORRECTION and the client-care fee is payable by the BUYER — have both answers cold. ⚠️ The addendum has now been unsigned on dotloop for roughly two days with no signature receipt, on a file where the closing agent already holds the earnest money.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $380K — four straight reads, every one blames size and layout, never price
listings.note: ⭐ SEVEN TOURS IN EIGHT DAYS ACROSS FIVE BROKERAGES and every price field on every form has come back blank. That is a photography-and-copy problem you can fix this week without touching the number, and it is far cheaper than the cut this traffic level would normally argue for. 🔥 The buyer-side thread that asked about competing offers is now on day four unanswered — still the only live buyer conversation this listing has. ⭐ It is also, separately, your best lead source: four of the eight names on today's call block came off this one ad.

listings.status: ✅ Under contract $899K — inspections done, appraisal clean, close date verbal-only
listings.note: ✅ NO RISK LEFT THAT YOUR SIDE CONTROLS, and it should stay that way. ⛔ BUT A VERBAL APPROVAL IS NOT AN ADDENDUM: the seller approved a move to August 20 through the office relay, and 8/14 remains the receipted contract date until something executed says otherwise. Both dates land in August, so the forecast does not move either way. ⭐ Say plainly that the slip is driven by their buyer's own sale, not anything on your side.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $559K — too high on the first read since the contract died, with an EIFS question behind it
listings.note: ⚠️ THE FIRST TOUR AFTER A RE-LIST IS THE READ A PROPERTY GETS GRADED ON, and this one came back too high with the worst staging score on file. The two reads before the contract both said JUST RIGHT, so the shift is real and recent. 🔴 A HARDER QUESTION SURFACED TUESDAY: there is no bond on the EIFS here. On synthetic stucco a buyer's inspector finds that independently, and it is a plausible part of why a contract already died once. ⚠️ This is also the one active transaction named on Tyler's compliance notice this morning.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $189K — the approved cut is now fourteen days old and still unverified
listings.note: 🔴 THE RISK IS TWO PUBLIC PRICES, NOT A SLOW SALE. A cut was approved two weeks ago with no receipt anywhere that it took effect in the MLS — on a listing whose only written read said the price was too high, and which has now gone twenty-three days without a showing. ✅ Two minutes to pull the MLS line and close it.

listings.status: 🔴 Active $364K — a read validated your price eight days ago and the seller still has not been told
listings.note: 🔴 DAY EIGHT OF A SELLER NOT HEARING GOOD NEWS. A price called JUST RIGHT by someone with no reason to flatter it, overall rating 4 of 5, is exactly what an out-of-state condo seller wants to hear. ⚠️ A validated price with no buyer is a marketing conversation — and you cannot have it with someone who does not know the price was validated.

listings.status: 🔴 Active — she called Friday and the tenant answer is now fourteen days owed
listings.note: 🔴 A CLIENT WHO HAS TO CHASE TWICE ON SOMETHING ORDINARY STARTS ASSUMING THE HARDER QUESTIONS WILL GO THE SAME WAY. Sixty seconds, whether or not you have the answer — "here is where it stands and here is when you will have it" resets the clock honestly. ⭐ She has since asked for two specific things in writing — the ceiling-height video and a colour question — so there is now a concrete reason to call rather than an apology to make.

listings.status: ⚠️ Active $1.15M — Sunday's open house is six days back and nothing has captured what happened at it
listings.note: ⚠️ YOUR MOST EXPENSIVE LISTING, SELLERS LIVING IN IT, and the only event it has had in a week exists only in your head. Five minutes of dictation makes it usable. ⭐ THE LAND COMPONENT IS PINNED NOW: the parcel runs 40 acres, and the one written objection this file has ever taken was about the land, not the price. ✅ A seller-side question on this address was solved into a call chip yesterday morning.

listings.status: 🔴 Buyer-side $2.35M — the largest number on your board, and your written position still has not gone across
listings.note: 🔴 FIVE ASKS AND TWO WEEKS OF SILENCE. Your own message told the other side you would entertain a reverse offer — a real position stated verbally with nothing on paper behind it. ⭐ The written feedback they have asked for five times IS your negotiating position; writing it is not a favour to them, it is putting your number on the record.

listings.status: 🔥 New cash deal — offer went 8/5 9:12 AM, seller countered by 5:12 PM the same day
listings.note: 🔥 AN OFFER-TO-COUNTER ROUND TRIP INSIDE ONE DAY, which is the fastest thing on this board by a wide margin. ✅ THE ACREAGE BLOCKER IS RETIRED: the seller's own two numbers imply roughly 157.6 acres — the first acreage ever stated on this tract — so the deal can finally be valued. ✅ Your buyer authorised the next number by text the same evening, and your counter went back the same night. ⚠️ There is a small conflict between two acreage figures now on file; it changes the math at the margins, not the deal.

listings.client: ⚠️ seller verified, property still unnamed on the paperwork

listings.note: 🆕 The signature is real and receipted; the parcel is not named anywhere in the document. ⚠️ Until it has an address it cannot be marketed, cannot be counted, and cannot be watched by any routine — it is inventory that exists only as a promise, and it is aging.

listings.addr: 225 Willow Point Cir · 3035 County Line Rd · 104 95th St N · 361 White Oak Cir
listings.status: Active — quiet, confirmed yours, and one of them has a listing appointment waiting on you
listings.note: ✅ THEY APPEAR HERE ON PURPOSE RATHER THAN BEING DROPPED — a listing that vanishes because nothing happened is how a seller goes ninety days without a call. 🔥 THE WILLOW POINT SELLERS ASKED FOR A LISTING APPOINTMENT AND NAMED THREE OPEN WINDOWS THEMSELVES — list one, buy another, and the ball has been in your court for nine days. Send a time, not a question. ✅ 361 White Oak finally got marketing after twenty-six dark days.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED — and the feedback you owe the other agent is now openly overdue
listings.note: 🎉 Closed and funded. ⚠️ The listing side asked for feedback three times and never got it. ⭐ The closing changed what that silence means — before it read as an oversight, now it reads as a shrug at the agent across the table.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED 7/30 — day nine, and the money still has not reached the bank
listings.note: ⚠️ A closing with no receipted commission nine days later is the shape of a problem, not a delay — especially in a week where the business account has been the constraint every single day.

listings.status: 🎉 CLOSED + FUNDED — one clean, one with a stranded payout
listings.note: ⚠️ WHISPERING PINES IS NO LONGER "NOTHING OWED": its payout is nine days stranded on an open agent-of-record question, and that question is the same teammate whose licence compliance is dated today. The two items are one item.

listings.note: ✅ Real money already on the board that had been missing from the count.

pipeline.note: ✅ THE COUNT IS SETTLED AND SHOULD NOT BE RE-LITIGATED — Monday's Weekly Pipeline & Forecast led with "THE COUNT IS SETTLED: GENE = 21. ACCOUNT-WIDE = 35," the item three consecutive weekly reviews called the fleet's worst bug. ⭐ 21 at day 218 is about 5.5 behind an on-pace 26.5 and annualises to 36. ⏰ THE REAL DEADLINE IS NOT DECEMBER 31 — at 60–75 days contract-to-close, anything counting for 2026 has to be under contract by roughly October 31, which is 12 weeks out. 🔥 AND THE ONE NUMBER THAT MOVES IT IS APPOINTMENTS: roughly 3.4 a week for 13 weeks. ⚠️ YESTERDAY PRODUCED NONE OF THEM AGAIN. The three real shots have not moved in four days — a seller who named three open windows herself and is waiting on you to pick a day, a Lot-Land agreement signed Monday whose parcel still has no name, and a land buyer on your own call list who has been hunting for two and a half years. ⏰ AND A NEW KIND OF LEAK OPENED THIS MORNING: two listings are inside their agreement-expiry window, one of them eight days out with a live offer on it. A lapsed agreement forfeits GCI you have already earned.

money.note: ✅ THE FIRST CLEAN DAY IN SEVEN — AND YOU EARNED IT IN TEN MINUTES. The transfer you made yesterday morning cleared before the day's withdrawals posted, and for the first time in a week nothing bounced, nothing was returned, and no fee was charged on either side. That is the good news and it is real. ⚠️ TWO THINGS KEEP THIS ON ALERT ANYWAY. First, the accounting system's connection to the bank EXPIRED overnight, so every cash number the books report is now unusable and materially overstated — the only trustworthy figure is the one stamped by the bank itself. Second, two large recurring bills that the calendar said would draft yesterday DID NOT DRAFT, which sounds like relief and is not: it means the calendar was wrong, the money is still owed, and nobody currently knows the real dates. ⚠️ Both of those were reclassified honestly this morning rather than left to look like a surplus. ⭐ THE MONTH ITSELF IS STILL NOT THE PROBLEM: August models above the survive line. September is the hole and it is still at zero — which is exactly what the appointment number on this board is for. ⚠️ And a closing from last week still has not paid, on an open agent-of-record question that is now tangled with a licence deadline dated today.

isa.decayPolicy: ⚠️ 46 OPEN, 18 OF THEM p1 — UP NINE OVERNIGHT, AND EVERY ADDITION CAME OFF A LIVE SIGNAL RATHER THAN A BACKLOG. ⭐ THE LIST IS WORKING AS DESIGNED, NOT ROTTING: several are contactless address-only seller records queued for re-check — records that arrived with no name, no phone and no email, correctly held at zero touch rather than guessed at — and the rest came straight out of texts and voicemails you were in the middle of. 🔥 THE p1 BLOCK IS WHERE THE MONEY IS: four named buyers off a single listing ad, one co-op agent holding a live buyer who wants to write, two brand-new buyers who were on your site last night, two separate land questions, and one seller you hold a SIGNED referral agreement on whose consult never happened. 🔴 THE NUMBER THAT SHOULD BOTHER YOU IS NOT 46 — IT IS THAT THE OLDEST p1 HAS ZERO TOUCHES OF ANY KIND, THREE DAYS IN. ⚠️ Six inbound leads still cannot be texted at all: they typed a number into your own form that carries a DNC marker, and no rule exists yet for what to do with them.
isa.sweepCadence: Every ~30 minutes through the send window, plus the instant responder on inbound. ✅ THE SEND LANE IS DEMONSTRABLY ALIVE, NOT JUST REPORTING ALIVE — a first-touch text went to last night's new buyer inside twenty minutes of his record landing, and two Real Talk follow-ups went out yesterday evening. ✅ THE LEAD LANE READ DRY ON EVERY OVERNIGHT PASS, verified two independent ways each time; that is a confirmed quiet lane, not a broken one. ⭐ AND THE SLOW LANES KEEP CATCHING WHAT THE FAST ONE MISSES: the voicemail pull surfaced live callers the text pull never saw, and a client's bounced email was recovered from a relay thread rather than lost. ✅ THE WARM-15 RECONNECT LANE IS BACK after five dark days — the fault was a path mismatch, not a dead sender: it was staging to Drive while the executor read this Mac. Fifteen are staged this morning against a fresh check, gate at 9:15. ⚠️ The responder still fires on every new address-only seller record and holds most of them at zero touch for lack of a phone number rather than lack of trying.
